<thought>Search for a retrosynthetic template that performs a retro‑SN2 disconnection: it breaks an alkyl halide and forms a secondary amine (C–N bond).</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["alkyl halide"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["secondary amines"],
  "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
